steps.stem: It is given that for all \(x > 1\), \({x}^{a} \cdot  {x}^{b} = {x}^{a \cdot  b}\) holds for particular values of a and b. Which of the following is necessarily true?
choices: None of the above is necessarily true.
explanation: By the product law, x^a · x^b = x^(a+b) always. If the same expression also equals x^(a·b) for all x > 1 , the exponents must coincide: a + b = a·b .
